message: Hi, I'm a student with a information security certification background. My overall academic average is 83.7% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in programming and system developer. I want to become a Web Developer. My family can afford at most about USD 4300 per year. I live in Chennai. I'm open to going abroad. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.
explanation:
This program is highly recommended as it offers an excellent balance of low cost and strong career prospects in Germany. With a minimal annual tuition of only $300 USD, the financial constraint is easily met while providing access to a robust job market. The high placement rate of 82% and a median starting salary of $51,059 USD significantly address your priority of securing good employment after graduation. Furthermore, the 18-month post-study work visa provides crucial time to gain professional experience in Germany.

This option is ideal for students prioritizing low tuition costs while still aiming for a strong career abroad. At only $450 USD annually, it fits well within your budget and offers an 82% placement rate in Germany. The median starting salary of $46,428 USD and the availability of an 18-month post-study work visa make this program highly attractive for job seekers. The main trade-off here is that the focus is on IT Support rather than core programming/web development.

This MSc program offers one of the highest placement rates (91%) among all candidates and provides a strong median starting salary of $56,198 USD. The low tuition fee of $950 USD is very budget-friendly for an international degree. While this option has a minimum grade requirement of 80%, which might be slightly higher than your current average, the superior job outcomes and 18-month work visa make it a top contender.
